relevant_laws.quote: If a highway has been designed to provide a single center lane to be used only for turning by traffic moving in both directions, the following rules apply: A vehicle must not travel more than 50 feet in a center turn lane after making a left-hand turn onto the highway before merging with traffic.
relevant_laws.relevance_type: left turn onto highway into shared center turn lane before through-lane merge
relevant_laws.notes: Highway designation, exact lane design and observed merge await original source review.
